notes: Cross-verse split with ACT.13.21 over a supplied English preposition governing a bare accusative object of αἰτέω. ACT.13.21 gives *for* to the verb because no Greek preposition stands; ACT.13.28 gave *of* to the name under a 'case preposition stays with the name' note that fits an oblique case (ACT.13.23's dative) and not an accusative object. Normalised to the verb, which is what licenses the preposition in English.
